scenario: 你要把一个 10TB 的事件表拆到一组服务器上，集群每月扩缩容一次，重建成本必须可控。
scenario_en: You must spread a 10 TB event table across a fleet of servers, and the cluster resizes every month, so reshuffling has to stay cheap.
q: 一致性哈希要解决的核心问题是什么？
options: 让哈希函数的输出更难被反推或碰撞，提升系统的加密安全性
把敏感业务数据做端到端加密，防止被中间人窃取
把数据分布到一组服务器上，并在节点增减时把重新分布的数据量降到最小
优化单机数据库的索引结构，让单节点在高并发查询下的延迟更低、吞吐更高
why: 一致性哈希是分布式系统的基础算法：解决「数据放哪台服务器」的问题，且在节点数量变化时只移动一小部分数据。
why_en: Consistent hashing distributes data across a cluster while minimizing how much data must move when servers are added or removed.
options_en: Make the hash function's output harder to reverse or collide, improving cryptographic security.
Encrypt sensitive business data end to end so it cannot be intercepted.
Spread data across a set of servers while minimizing how much data must move when nodes join or leave.
Optimize a single database's index structure so one node handles high-concurrency queries with lower latency and higher throughput.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把任意长度输入映射成固定长度数值的函数，常用来快速定位数据。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A hash function maps input of any length to a fixed-size number, used to quickly locate data.

q_en: What core problem does consistent hashing solve?
optionExplanations: 这是在说哈希的抗碰撞/抗反推能力，属于密码学范畴，和「数据该放哪台机器」这个分片问题不是一回事。
端到端加密解决的是数据保密性，不涉及把数据切分到哪台服务器，跟一致性哈希要回答的问题无关。
一致性哈希就是解决这个：把 key 分散到多台服务器，还要保证节点增减时只搬一小部分数据。
这是单机索引优化的问题，一致性哈希面对的是「多机怎么分」，不是「单机怎么快」。
optionExplanations_en: That's about hash collision resistance, a cryptography concern, not about which server holds which piece of data.
End-to-end encryption is about confidentiality, not about deciding which server stores which key.
This is exactly the problem: spread keys across servers while keeping the reshuffle small when nodes join or leave.
That's single-node index tuning; consistent hashing is about splitting data across many machines, not speeding up one.

scenario: 单台 Postgres 写入已顶到 IOPS 上限，团队决定把数据横向拆到多个实例来分摊写压力。
scenario_en: A single Postgres box has hit its IOPS ceiling, so the team splits the data horizontally across several instances to share the write load.
q: 单库扛不住负载时，把数据分布到多个数据库实例的过程叫什么？
options: 复制（replication）
分片（sharding）
归档（archiving）
缓存（caching）
why: 分片是把数据水平拆分到多个实例；随之而来的第一个问题就是「哪条数据存到哪个实例」——这正是哈希分配策略要回答的。
why_en: Sharding means distributing data across multiple database instances, which raises the question of which data lives on which instance.
options_en: Replication
Sharding
Archiving
Caching
q_en: When one database cannot handle the load, what is the process of spreading data across multiple database instances called?

termDefinitions.meaning: 把同一份数据保留多份拷贝，用来提高可用性或读吞吐。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Replication keeps multiple copies of the same data to improve availability or read throughput.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把数据水平拆到多个实例上，让容量和吞吐能横向扩展。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Sharding splits data horizontally across instances so capacity and throughput can scale out.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把常读数据放到更快的存储层，减少后端数据库压力。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Caching keeps frequently read data in a faster layer to reduce pressure on the backing database.

optionExplanations: 复制是多份拷贝同一份数据以提高可用性/读吞吐，不是把数据切开分给多台实例。
把数据水平拆到多个实例上、各自扛一部分负载，这正是分片，也是本题问的过程。
归档是把冷数据搬到低成本存储长期保留，不解决单库扛不住负载的问题。
缓存是把常读数据放进更快的层减轻数据库压力，不是把数据切分到多个实例。
optionExplanations_en: Replication copies the same data to multiple places for availability, it doesn't split data across instances.
Splitting data horizontally across instances so each one carries a share of the load is exactly sharding.
Archiving moves cold data to cheap long-term storage; it doesn't relieve an overloaded single database.
Caching puts hot data in a faster layer to ease database pressure, it doesn't partition data across instances.

q: 补全最朴素的取模分片流程：
text: 取模分片：先对 event ID 做{{哈希}}得到一个数字，再对{{数据库数量}}取模（%），结果就是目标实例编号：database_id = hash(event_id) % N。
why: 取模哈希实现最简单、分布也均匀，但它把「节点数量」写死进了映射关系——这就是后面所有问题的根源。
why_en: Modulo sharding hashes the key and takes it modulo the number of databases, which bakes the cluster size into the mapping.
diagram:
flowchart LR
  A["key"] --> B["hash key"]
  B --> C["mod N"]
  C --> D["DB index"]

termDefinitions.meaning: 取余数运算，hash(key) % N 的结果是 0 到 N-1 之间的余数。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Modulo returns the remainder of division, so hash(key) % N yields a value between 0 and N minus 1.

q_en: Fill in the basic modulo-sharding flow:
text_en: Modulo sharding: first {{hash}} the event ID into a number, then take modulo by the {{database count}}; the result is the target instance: database_id = hash(event_id) % N.

scenario: 取模分片的 3 台库要扩到 4 台，业务要求扩容期间线上读写不中断。
scenario_en: A modulo-sharded cluster of three databases is growing to four, and live reads and writes must not stop during the expansion.
q: 取模分片下从 3 台库扩到 4 台（% 3 改成 % 4），会发生什么？
options: 只有新加的第四台库需要接收数据，其余三台库的现有路由保持原样、一个 key 都不用搬
几乎每个 key 的目标库都变了——绝大部分数据要跨库搬迁，所有实例负载暴涨
什么都不用动，取模结果的变化会被数据库自动兼容处理，无需人工干预
只有四分之一的新增数据会被分配到新库，旧数据原地不动、不受影响
why: 模数一变，几乎所有 key 的哈希结果落点都变了：不只是新实例，而是全部实例之间的大规模数据搬迁，数据库活动全面飙升。
why_en: Changing the modulus remaps almost every key, forcing massive data movement across all instances, not just the new one.
options_en: Only the newly added fourth instance needs to receive data; the other three keep their existing routing unchanged and not a single key moves.
Almost every key's target database changes — most data must move across instances and load spikes everywhere.
Nothing needs to change; the database automatically reconciles the new modulo result with no manual work.
Only about a quarter of the newly written data goes to the new instance; old data stays put, unaffected.
q_en: Under modulo sharding, what happens when you scale from 3 databases to 4?
optionExplanations: 取模的分母一变，几乎所有 key 的余数都会变，不会只有新库单独收数据，旧三台的路由也全乱了。
模数从 3 变 4，几乎每个 key 的 hash%N 结果都变了，绝大部分数据要跨库搬迁，四台库负载都会飙升。
数据库不会自动兼容取模结果的变化，旧路由失效后必须真的把数据搬到新位置才能读对。
受影响的不只是新数据——旧数据的余数同样会变，绝不是只有四分之一新增数据受影响。
optionExplanations_en: Changing the divisor shifts almost every key's remainder, not just routing fresh data to the new instance while the rest stays put.
With the modulus going from 3 to 4, nearly every key's hash%N result changes, so most data must move and every instance feels the spike.
Databases don't auto-reconcile a changed modulo result; the data actually has to move or the routing points to the wrong place.
It's not only new writes affected — old records' remainders shift too, so far more than a quarter of the data moves.

scenario: 取模分片集群从 3 台扩到 4 台，你在核对事件 #1234 扩容前后的落点，决定它要不要迁移。
scenario_en: A modulo-sharded cluster grows from three nodes to four, and you check where event #1234 lands before and after to decide if it must move.
q: 举例：事件 #1234 原来 hash(1234) % 3 = 1 存在 DB1；扩容后 hash(1234) % 4 = 0，说明什么？
options: 这条数据必须从 DB1 搬到 DB0——而且这不是个例，是普遍现象
数据会短暂同时存在两个库，直到后台同步任务清理旧副本，才彻底结束
这条数据在搬迁过程中彻底丢了，需要从最近一次备份手工逐条恢复
只有本次新写入的数据受影响，历史数据的库位置保持不变、无需处理
why: 同一个 key 在新模数下落到了不同实例，旧位置的数据必须搬走；取模分片下绝大多数 key 都是这样。
why_en: Under the new modulus the same key maps to a different database, so its data must move, and most keys share this fate.
options_en: This record must move from DB1 to DB0 — and this is not an isolated case, it's the norm.
The record briefly exists in both databases until a background job finishes cleaning up the old copy.
The record was completely lost during the move and must be restored from the latest backup by hand, record by record.
Only newly written data is affected; existing records keep their old database location and need no action.
q_en: What does this modulo example tell us about event #1234 after scale-out?
optionExplanations: hash(1234) 在新模数下落到了不同实例，这条数据确实要从 DB1 搬到 DB0，而且取模分片下大多数 key 都这样。
取模重新映射不会让数据自动留一份旧副本等着清理，是路由直接换了，没有这种双写过渡态。
重新映射不等于丢失，数据只是路由指向变了，只要按新位置正确搬迁就不会丢。
受影响的不只是新写入——已有的历史数据同样会因为模数变化换库，这条例子就是历史数据搬迁的例子。
optionExplanations_en: Under the new modulus this key really does land on a different instance, and that's the common case, not the exception, under modulo sharding.
Remapping under modulo doesn't leave a lingering duplicate for cleanup — routing simply changes, there's no such dual-write window.
Remapping isn't loss; the data just needs to move to where the new routing points, not vanish.
It's not only new writes that move — this very example is an existing record whose database changed.

scenario: 取模分片的 3 台库半夜挂了一台，值班要把它移出池子，剩下 2 台继续扛线上流量。
scenario_en: One of three modulo-sharded databases dies at night; on-call pulls it from the pool and the remaining two must keep serving traffic.
q: 取模分片下一台数据库宕机（硬件故障/软件 bug），把它移出池子后会怎样？
options: 剩余节点会自动均分它的数据，其他数据完全不受任何影响
系统会自动恢复到正常状态，完全无需搬迁任何数据
只会丢失宕机节点自己原本负责的那部分数据而已
% 3 变成 % 2，和扩容一样触发几乎全量的重新分布
why: 缩容和扩容是同一个病：模数从 3 变 2，几乎所有 key 重新映射——故障时最脆弱的时刻反而要做最大规模的搬迁。
why_en: Removing a failed node changes the modulus and triggers the same near-total redistribution as adding one.
options_en: The remaining nodes automatically split its data evenly; nothing else is affected at all.
The system automatically recovers back to normal, with no data movement needed whatsoever.
Only the data the failed node itself was originally responsible for gets lost.
The modulus changes from 3 to 2, triggering the same near-total redistribution as scaling up.
q_en: Under modulo sharding, what happens when a failed database is removed from the pool?
optionExplanations: 剩余节点不会只是接手宕机那台的数据——模数变了，连它们原有的数据归属也会跟着重新洗牌。
取模分片没有「自动恢复」这回事，节点数变化后必须真的重新计算并搬迁数据才能继续正确路由。
损失不会局限在宕机节点：模数一变，几乎全部 key 的目标库都变了，不只丢一台的数据。
移出一台库等于 % 3 变 % 2，和扩容同理会触发几乎全量重新映射——故障时反而要做最大规模搬迁。
optionExplanations_en: Survivors don't just absorb the failed node's data as-is — the modulus changes too, so their own existing keys get reshuffled as well.
Modulo sharding has no auto-recovery; the node count change forces an actual recomputation and data move to route correctly again.
The damage isn't confined to the failed node — nearly every key's target database changes once the modulus shifts.
Removing one node turns %3 into %2, triggering the same near-total remapping as scaling up, right when the system is most fragile.

scenario: 分片集群正在做全量数据重分布，同一时间线上还得继续承接用户读写。
scenario_en: A sharded cluster is running a full data reshuffle while it still has to serve live user reads and writes.
q: 大规模数据重新分布对线上系统的直接伤害是？
options: 数据库负载出现巨大尖峰，用户要么访问不到数据、要么响应变慢
只是磁盘占用短暂翻倍，几分钟后自动回落到正常水平
没有实际影响，因为搬迁流量会被系统自动限速、排到后台低峰期慢慢执行，前台无感
数据永久丢失，必须从最近一次全量备份整体恢复
why: 搬迁本身要吃大量 IO 和带宽：数据库活动飙升，正常请求被挤压，表现为不可用或高延迟。
why_en: Mass redistribution spikes database load so users see slow responses or cannot access data at all.
options_en: Database load spikes hard, so users either cannot reach data or see slow responses.
Disk usage briefly doubles and settles back down within minutes.
No real impact, because the migration traffic is automatically throttled and queued to run slowly in off-peak hours, invisible to the foreground.
Data is permanently lost and must be restored wholesale from the last full backup.
q_en: What direct harm does large-scale data redistribution cause in production?
optionExplanations: 大规模搬迁要占满 IO 和带宽，数据库负载瞬间飙高，正常读写被挤占，表现为超时或访问不到数据。
磁盘占用短暂翻倍不是主要伤害，真正的问题是搬迁期间的 IO 和请求争抢，不会几分钟就自动回落。
搬迁不会被自动限速到低峰期——它是同步触发的，流量高峰期照样硬扛全部重分布压力。
重分布不是数据丢失事件，数据仍然存在，只是暂时搬得慢、读写受阻，不需要整体从备份恢复。
optionExplanations_en: Mass migration eats IO and bandwidth, so database load spikes hard and normal reads and writes get crowded out, timing out or failing.
Doubled disk usage isn't the real damage; the actual hit is IO and request contention during the move, and it doesn't just settle in minutes.
The move isn't auto-throttled to off-peak — it fires immediately, so peak traffic has to absorb the full redistribution load too.
Redistribution isn't a data-loss event; the data still exists, just slow to move and blocking reads, no backup restore needed.

scenario: 你要设计一套 key→节点 的映射，要求节点数从 N 变成 N+1 时，绝大多数 key 的归属不变。
scenario_en: You need a key-to-node mapping where almost every key keeps the same owner when the node count goes from N to N plus one.
q: 一致性哈希的关键洞见是什么？
options: 换用密码学强度更高的哈希函数，以此来减少碰撞概率
把所有数据复制到集群里的每一个节点，读写都本地完成
把数据和服务器节点都安排在同一个环形哈希空间（hash ring）上
用一棵二叉搜索树按 key 范围来组织所有节点，查找归属时逐层走树形路径向下定位
why: 核心思想：数据和数据库都映射到同一个圆环上；key 的归属由「环上顺时针遇到的第一个节点」决定，而不是由节点总数决定。
why_en: The key insight is to place both data and servers on a circular hash ring so ownership no longer depends on the total node count.
diagram:
flowchart TD
  A["hash key"] --> B["point on ring"]
  B --> C["walk clockwise"]
  C --> D["first node owns key"]
options_en: Switch to a cryptographically stronger hash function, in order to reduce collision odds.
Replicate all data to every single node in the cluster so reads and writes stay local.
Place both data and server nodes on the same circular hash space, the hash ring.
Organize all nodes in a binary search tree keyed by range and walk down the tree level by level to look up ownership.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把哈希值空间首尾相接成一个环，数据和节点都映射到环上的位置。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A hash ring wraps the hash-value space into a circle onto which both data and nodes are mapped.

q_en: What is the key insight behind consistent hashing?
optionExplanations: 换更强的哈希函数只提升抗碰撞性，不解决节点增减时数据要搬多少的问题，不是一致性哈希的核心。
全量复制到每个节点能保证本地读写，但完全放弃了横向扩展容量的意义，不是这里的洞见。
把数据和节点都映射到同一个环上、按顺时针找归属，这样归属只看相邻关系，节点变化的影响才是局部的。
按 key 范围建二叉搜索树是另一种路由结构，但一致性哈希的关键洞见是环 + 顺时针查找，不是树。
optionExplanations_en: A stronger hash function only reduces collisions; it doesn't address how much data moves when nodes change, so that's not the key idea.
Replicating everything to every node keeps reads local, but it throws away the point of scaling out capacity — not the insight here.
Placing both data and servers on one circular space and walking clockwise makes ownership purely local, so membership changes stay bounded.
A range-keyed binary search tree is a different routing structure; the actual insight is the ring plus clockwise lookup, not a tree.

q: 补全一致性哈希的查找流程：
text: 先把 key 做哈希、定位到环上的一个点，然后沿{{顺时针}}方向走，遇到的第一个{{节点}}就是这个 key 的归属；节点增减时只有{{相邻区间}}的 key 需要移动。
why: 「环 + 顺时针找下一个节点」就是一致性哈希的全部核心；正因为归属只看相邻关系，节点变化的影响才是局部的。
why_en: Hash the key onto the ring and walk clockwise to the first node, so membership changes only affect the adjacent range of keys.
q_en: Fill in the lookup flow for consistent hashing:
text_en: Hash the key to a point on the ring, walk {{clockwise}}, and the first {{node}} you meet owns the key; when nodes change, only the {{adjacent range}} moves.

q: 以下哪个最像生产系统常用的哈希环取值空间？
options: 0 到 2^32 - 1（32 位哈希空间；也有系统用 64 位或 128 位）
why: 0-100 只是教学简化。生产环境要用足够大的哈希空间，让几百个虚拟节点几乎不撞位置、分布均匀：常见的是 32 位空间 0 到 2^32-1（约 43 亿个位置，如 Ketama），也有更大的——Cassandra 的 Murmur3 token 是 64 位，Dynamo 论文用 MD5 的 128 位。关键是「足够大」，不是固定 32 位。
why_en: Zero to one hundred is a teaching simplification. Production rings use a space large enough that hundreds of virtual nodes almost never collide: a 32-bit space (about 4.3 billion positions, as in Ketama) is common, and some go bigger — Cassandra's Murmur3 tokens are 64-bit and the Dynamo paper uses MD5's 128-bit space. The point is "large enough", not "always 32 bits".
options_en: Zero to one hundred
Zero to two to the thirty-second minus one (a 32-bit space; some systems use 64 or 128 bits)
Zero to one thousand
Zero to two to the eighth power minus one

termDefinitions.meaning: 哈希函数所有可能输出值组成的取值范围。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The hash space is the full range of possible output values a hash function can produce.

scenario: 你在实现一致性哈希的环结构，要决定哈希函数输出值的取值范围。这个范围决定环上能装下多少个不重合的位置；你需要几百个虚拟节点也几乎不撞位置。
q_en: Which of these looks most like a hash-ring range used in production?
scenario_en: You are implementing a consistent-hashing ring and must choose the hash-function output range, which controls how many distinct ring positions exist; you need hundreds of virtual nodes to almost never collide.

scenario: 哈希环大小 100，4 台库在位置 0/25/50/75，路由层要在一次查表内定出 key 的归属节点。
scenario_en: On a ring of size 100 with databases at 0, 25, 50 and 75, the router must resolve a key’s owner in a single lookup.
q: 环大小 100，4 台数据库在位置 0、25、50、75。某 key 哈希到位置 60，归谁？
options: 位置 50 的数据库
位置 75 的数据库
位置 0 的数据库
位置 25 的数据库
why: 从 60 出发顺时针走，遇到的第一个节点在 75——key 归位置 75 的数据库。注意是「向前找下一个」，不是「找最近的」。
why_en: Walking clockwise from sixty, the first node you meet is at seventy-five, so that database owns the key.
options_en: The database at position 50.
The database at position 75.
The database at position 0.
The database at position 25.
q_en: With ring size 100 and nodes at 0, 25, 50, and 75, who owns a key at position 60?
optionExplanations: 50 在 60 的逆时针方向，顺时针查找永远不会往回走，所以不会归 50。
从 60 顺时针走，第一个遇到的节点在 75，一致性哈希按「向前找下一个」而不是「找最近的」来判归属。
0 在环上更靠后才能顺时针到达（要绕一整圈），60 顺时针方向最先碰到的不是它。
25 在 60 的顺时针方向之前（逆时针），从 60 出发根本不会先经过 25。
optionExplanations_en: 50 sits counter-clockwise from 60, and a clockwise walk never goes backward, so it can't be the owner.
Walking clockwise from 60, the first node you hit is 75 — ownership goes to the next node forward, not the nearest one.
0 is reached only after wrapping most of the way around; it isn't the first node clockwise from 60.
25 lies behind 60 in the clockwise direction, so starting at 60 you'd never reach it first.

scenario: 同一个大小 100 的环（节点 0/25/50/75），路由层要处理哈希值超过最后一个节点位置的 key。
scenario_en: On the same ring of size 100 with nodes at 0, 25, 50 and 75, the router must handle a key whose hash lands past the last node position.
q: 同样的环（节点在 0、25、50、75），某 key 哈希到位置 80，归谁？
options: 位置 75 的数据库（它在逆时针侧）
位置 50 的数据库
没有归属，报错
位置 0 的数据库（顺时针回绕）
why: 80 之后顺时针没有更大的节点位置了，于是回绕（wrap around）到环的起点——位置 0 的节点接住它。环是首尾相接的。
why_en: Past the last node the walk wraps around the ring, so a key at eighty belongs to the node at position zero.
options_en: The database at position 75, which sits counter-clockwise.
The database at position 50.
No owner; it errors out.
The database at position 0, via clockwise wrap-around.

termDefinitions.meaning: 沿环走到末尾后，逻辑上接回环的起点继续查找。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Wrap-around means that after reaching the end of the ring, the walk logically continues from the start.

q_en: On the same ring, who owns a key at position 80?
optionExplanations: 75 在 80 的逆时针方向，顺时针查找不会往回跳到它。
50 离 80 更远也在逆时针方向，顺时针查找同样不会经过它。
环是首尾相接的，80 之后顺时针没有更大节点位置了会直接回绕，不会报错找不到归属。
顺时针在 80 后面找不到更大的位置，于是环绕回到起点，落在 0 号节点头上。
optionExplanations_en: 75 sits counter-clockwise from 80, so a clockwise walk never jumps back to it.
50 is even further counter-clockwise from 80, so the clockwise walk never reaches it either.
The ring wraps end to end, so past 80 the walk simply loops back to the start instead of erroring out.
Past 80 there's no larger node position clockwise, so the walk logically wraps to the ring's start, and the node at 0 takes it.

scenario: 环上节点在 0/25/50/75，为扩容在位置 90 加入 DB5，运维要先估算这次搬迁的影响面。
scenario_en: With nodes at 0, 25, 50 and 75, DB5 joins at position 90 for extra capacity, and ops must first estimate how much data this touches.
q: 环上节点在 0、25、50、75，现在在位置 90 加入 DB5。哪些数据需要移动？
options: 所有数据都要重新分布，四台旧库和新库之间发生大规模互相搬迁
只有位置 0-25 之间、原本归 DB2 的那部分数据会搬到新库
只有哈希到 75-90 区间的 key 会移动——原本归 DB1，现在归 DB5
位置 50-75 之间的数据会被重新分配到新库 DB5，原持有者 DB4 那段区间被完全清空搬走
why: 新节点只「切走」它逆时针方向到上一个节点之间的区间（75-90）；这些 key 原本回绕给 DB1，现在就近归 DB5，其余数据原地不动。
why_en: Only keys hashing between seventy-five and ninety move, since they previously wrapped to the node at zero and now belong to the new node.
diagram:
flowchart LR
    K["75-90 区间的 key"] -->|before| DB1["DB1 位置 0"]
    K -->|after DB5 joins| DB5["DB5 位置 90"]
    O["其余所有 key"] --> S["原地不动"]
options_en: All data gets redistributed; the four old databases and the new one all shuffle data around.
Only the data between positions 0 and 25 moves.
Only keys hashing into the 75-to-90 range move — they used to belong to DB1 and now belong to DB5.
Data between positions 50 and 75 gets reassigned to the new DB5 and its original holder DB4 has that whole range emptied and moved away.
q_en: A new DB5 joins at position 90. Which data needs to move?
optionExplanations: 新节点只切走它逆时针到上一个节点之间的那段区间，不会让四台旧库和新库互相大搬迁。
0-25 区间是 DB2 的地盘，跟新加的 DB5（90 附近）完全无关，不会因为 DB5 加入而搬动。
DB5 只从它逆时针方向到上一个节点（75）之间切走一段，也就是 75-90 这段之前是绕回 DB1 的，现在换成它来接。
50-75 是 DB4 原本的区间；DB5 加在 90，只从上一个节点 75 到 90 之间切走一段，动不到 50-75。
optionExplanations_en: The new node only claims the stretch back to its previous neighbor; it doesn't trigger a shuffle among all four old databases.
The 0-to-25 range belongs to DB2, nowhere near the new DB5 at 90, so joining there doesn't touch it.
DB5 only claims the stretch back to its previous neighbor at 75, meaning keys from 75 to 90 that used to wrap to DB1 now go to DB5.
The 50-to-75 range belongs to DB4; DB5 joins at 90 and only claims the 75-to-90 stretch before it, so it never touches 50-75.

q: 在位置 90 加入 DB5，移动的数据量大约是多少？
options: 全部数据的约 50%，因为新库要跟旧库对半分担负载
约 DB1 的 60%（25 个单位里的 15 个），即全部数据的约 15%
全部数据的约 90%，因为几乎所有 key 的顺时针归属都变了
不到 1%，只有极少数刚好精确哈希到位置 90 这一个点上的 key 才会发生移动，其余全部原地不动
why: 只动 75-90 这 15 个单位：占 DB1 跨度（25 单位）的 60%、占整个环的约 15%——对比取模哈希的「几乎全量」，这就是一致性哈希的价值。
why_en: Only about sixty percent of one node's keys, roughly fifteen percent of all data, moves, versus nearly everything under modulo hashing.
scenario: 环大小 100，节点在 0、25、50、75；在位置 90 新增 DB5 后，原本 75-90 这段 key 从 DB1 改归 DB5，其余区间不受影响。
options_en: About 50% of all data, since the new node should split load evenly with the old one.
About 60% of DB1's data (15 of its 25-unit span), roughly 15% of all data.
About 90% of all data, since nearly every key's clockwise owner changes.
Less than 1%, since only the rare keys hashing to exactly position 90 would move at all, with everything else staying put.
q_en: Roughly how much data moves when DB5 joins at position 90?
scenario_en: The ring size is 100 with nodes at 0, 25, 50, and 75. After DB5 joins at position 90, keys from 75 to 90 move from DB1 to DB5.
optionExplanations: 50% 假设新旧库对半分担，但一致性哈希只让新节点切走它相邻的一段，不是整体重新分配。
DB5 只切走 75-90 这 15 个单位，占 DB1 那 25 个单位跨度的 60%，相当于整个环约 15%——这正是一致性哈希只动局部的体现。
90% 是取模哈希扩容才会出现的量级，一致性哈希恰恰是为了避免这种几乎全量重排才存在的。
只影响精确落在 90 这一个点的 key 太夸张了，实际是 75-90 整段区间的 key 都要挪，不是单个点。
optionExplanations_en: Fifty percent assumes an even split between old and new, but consistent hashing only lets the new node claim its adjacent slice, not a full reshuffle.
DB5 only takes the 15-unit stretch from 75 to 90 — 60% of DB1's 25-unit span, roughly 15% of the whole ring — exactly the localized movement consistent hashing promises.
Ninety percent is the modulo-hashing scale of damage; consistent hashing exists precisely to avoid that kind of near-total remap.
Limiting it to keys hashing to exactly position 90 undercounts it — the whole 75-to-90 range moves, not a single point.

scenario: 环上节点在 0/25/50/75，位置 25 的 DB2 突然宕机，路由层必须立刻给它的 key 找到接管者。
scenario_en: With nodes at 0, 25, 50 and 75, DB2 at position 25 suddenly crashes, and the router must immediately find who takes over its keys.
q: 环上节点在 0、25、50、75，位置 25 的 DB2 宕机后，它的数据去哪？
options: 全部顺时针滑给下一个节点——位置 50 的 DB3；其他数据原地不动
平均摊派给所有剩余节点，DB1、DB3、DB4 三家各自接手其中的三分之一数据量
回绕给位置 0 的 DB1，因为它是环上最后一个节点
永久丢失，必须人工逐条从最近备份里恢复
why: 节点消失后，原本落在它区间的 key 继续顺时针走，全部落到下一个节点 DB3；环上其他区间完全不受影响。
why_en: When a node fails its keys simply continue clockwise to the next node, and everything else stays put.
options_en: All of it slides clockwise to the next node, DB3 at position 50; everything else stays put.
It splits evenly across all remaining nodes — DB1, DB3, and DB4 each taking a third of the data.
It wraps around to DB1 at position 0, since that is the last node on the ring.
It is permanently lost and must be restored record by record from the latest backup.
q_en: If DB2 at position 25 fails, where does its data go?
optionExplanations: DB2 一下线，它那段区间的 key 就沿顺时针继续往前走，整批落到 DB3 头上，别处丝毫不受牵连。
均分给所有节点是取模式的想象，一致性哈希故障时只有顺时针邻居接盘，不会三家平分。
0 号节点是逆时针方向，不是 DB2 失效后顺时针查找会碰到的下一个节点，不会回绕到它。
顺时针邻居会正常接管这部分 key，不存在丢失，也不用从备份手工恢复。
optionExplanations_en: Once a node disappears, keys that landed in its range simply continue clockwise to the next node, DB3, while everything else stays untouched.
Splitting evenly across survivors is how modulo hashing would behave; on the ring, only the clockwise neighbor picks it up, not all three.
Node 0 sits counter-clockwise from DB2, not the next node a clockwise walk hits after DB2 fails, so it doesn't wrap there.
The clockwise neighbor simply takes over that range; nothing is lost and no manual backup restore is involved.

scenario: 朴素一致性哈希（无虚拟节点）的 4 节点集群，每台常态 70% CPU，现在 DB2 挂了。
scenario_en: In a four-node ring without virtual nodes, each machine normally runs at 70% CPU, and now DB2 goes down.
q: 没有虚拟节点时，DB2 宕机、数据全给了顺时针邻居 DB3，带来什么新问题？
options: DB3 的数据会整体损坏，必须动用最近一次全量备份逐条恢复重建
环在拓扑结构上直接断裂，其余节点之间的顺时针查找关系全部失效
DB1 的负载会显著下降，因为 DB2 失效后它再也不用承担原本那一段区间里任何一个 key 的服务
DB3 承担了双倍负载，而 DB1、DB4 闲着——失效负载全砸在一个邻居身上
why: 朴素一致性哈希的软肋：节点失效时它的全部负载只由顺时针的那一个邻居接盘，负载瞬间翻倍——这正是虚拟节点要解决的。
why_en: Without virtual nodes a failed node dumps its entire load onto its single clockwise neighbor, doubling that node's load.
options_en: DB3's data becomes corrupted and must be rebuilt record by record from the latest full backup.
The ring topologically breaks apart and clockwise lookups between the remaining nodes all fail.
DB1's load drops noticeably, because after DB2 fails it no longer has to serve any key in the range it used to hold.
DB3 now carries double the load while DB1 and DB4 sit idle — the failed node's load lands entirely on one neighbor.
q_en: Without virtual nodes, what new problem appears when DB2 fails and DB3 takes all its data?
optionExplanations: 数据没有损坏，只是量翻倍了；这题问的是负载失衡而不是数据完整性问题。
环的拓扑结构没有断裂，顺时针查找规则照常有效，只是负载分布不均衡了。
DB1 的负载不会下降，它服务的 key 区间没变，真正变化的是 DB3 突然要接住双倍数据。
没有虚拟节点时，DB2 的全部负载只由它唯一的顺时针邻居 DB3 接盘，DB3 瞬间扛双倍、DB1 和 DB4 完全没分担。
optionExplanations_en: No data gets corrupted, just doubled in volume; the issue here is load imbalance, not data integrity.
The ring's topology doesn't break; clockwise lookup still works fine — the problem is the load distribution becomes uneven.
DB1's load doesn't drop since the keys it serves are unchanged; the real shift is DB3 suddenly absorbing double the data.
Without virtual nodes, DB2's entire load falls on its one clockwise neighbor, DB3, doubling it instantly while DB1 and DB4 sit idle.

scenario: 你要在一致性哈希实现里加虚拟节点，让每台物理库在环上占据多个位置。
scenario_en: You are adding virtual nodes to a consistent-hashing implementation so each physical database occupies several ring positions.
q: 虚拟节点（virtual nodes）是怎么实现的？
options: 为每个节点单独采购多台物理备用整机，接口层做故障转移热备份
把节点名加不同后缀（vn1、vn2…）分别哈希，让一台物理机出现在环上多个位置
提前把整个哈希环硬编码切分成固定的一百个等份格子，每个物理节点静态认领其中若干个格子
用虚拟化技术把每台物理机替换成若干独立运行的虚拟机实例
why: 一台物理节点 = 环上多个点：哈希「DB1-vn1」「DB1-vn2」等得到多个位置，各节点的虚拟节点自然交错混排在环上。
why_en: Each server is hashed under several name variants so it appears at many ring positions, naturally interleaving with other servers.
diagram:
flowchart LR
  A["DB1 vnode A"] --> B["DB2 vnode A"]
  B --> C["DB1 vnode B"]
  C --> D["DB3 vnode A"]
options_en: Buy several extra physical standby machines per node and fail over at the interface layer.
Hash the node's name under different suffixes (vn1, vn2, ...) so one physical machine lands at multiple ring positions.
Pre-partition the whole ring into a hardcoded one hundred equal cells and have each physical node statically claim a fixed share of those cells.
Use virtualization to replace each physical machine with several independently running virtual machines.

termDefinitions.meaning: 给一台物理服务器在环上生成多个哈希位置的技术，用来让负载分布更均匀。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A virtual node technique hashes a physical server under several name variants so it occupies multiple ring positions for more even load.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把哈希值空间首尾相接成一个环，数据和节点都映射到环上的位置。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A hash ring wraps the hash-value space into a circle onto which both data and nodes are mapped.

q_en: How are virtual nodes implemented?
optionExplanations: 多买物理备用机是硬件冗余方案，跟虚拟节点让一台机器在环上出现多次完全不是一回事。
给节点名加不同后缀分别哈希，一台物理机就能在环上占据多个位置，和其他节点的虚拟点自然交错。
硬编码切成固定一百等份是另一种静态分区方式，不是虚拟节点靠哈希多个名字变体实现的思路。
虚拟化技术把一台物理机拆成多个 VM 是资源隔离手段，跟一致性哈希环上的虚拟节点是两个不同概念。
optionExplanations_en: Buying extra physical standby machines is hardware redundancy, nothing like one physical machine appearing at multiple ring positions.
Hashing the node's name under different suffixes makes one physical machine occupy several ring positions, naturally interleaving with others.
Hardcoding a fixed hundred equal slots is a different static-partition idea, not the hash-multiple-name-variants trick virtual nodes use.
Splitting one physical machine into several VMs is resource isolation, a completely different concept from ring-based virtual nodes.

scenario: 集群每台库配 150 个虚拟节点、全部交错分布在环上，此时 DB2 宕机。
scenario_en: Each database in the cluster owns 150 virtual nodes interleaved around the ring, and now DB2 goes down.
q: 有了虚拟节点后，DB2 宕机时会发生什么？
options: DB2 的虚拟节点分别由不同节点接手，失效负载被均摊给所有幸存节点
所有数据仍然只会整体滑给它在环上唯一的那个顺时针邻居，导致那一个邻居负载直接翻倍不变
整个哈希环都需要停机重新构建，所有节点重新计算环上位置
必须先由运维人工手动把数据迁移到目标节点
why: DB2 的虚拟节点散布在环上各处，每一段的顺时针邻居都不同，所以失效负载被自然摊薄——不再压垮单个邻居。
why_en: Because a failed node's virtual positions are scattered, each segment falls to a different survivor and the load spreads evenly.
options_en: DB2's virtual-node ranges are picked up by different nodes each, so the failed load spreads evenly across all survivors.
All of it still slides in one piece to its single clockwise neighbor on the ring, so that one neighbor's load simply doubles unchanged.
The whole hash ring must be rebuilt offline while every node recomputes its position.
An operator must first migrate the data to the target node by hand.

termDefinitions.meaning: 给一台物理服务器在环上生成多个哈希位置的技术，用来让负载分布更均匀。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A virtual node technique hashes a physical server under several name variants so it occupies multiple ring positions for more even load.

q_en: With virtual nodes, what happens when DB2 fails?
optionExplanations: DB2 拆成的那些虚拟位置本来就分散在环上各处，各自的顺时针邻居都不一样，冲击自然被摊到多个幸存节点身上。
翻倍不变是没有虚拟节点时的情形；有了虚拟节点，冲击已经被打散到多个节点身上。
虚拟节点不需要停机重建整个环，节点消失只影响它散落在环上的那几段区间。
故障接管靠的是自动顺时针查找规则，不需要运维人工搬迁数据。
optionExplanations_en: DB2's virtual positions are scattered around the ring, so each affected segment falls to a different survivor, spreading the load naturally.
Unchanged doubling is what happens without virtual nodes; with them, the impact is already spread across several survivors.
Virtual nodes don't require an offline rebuild of the whole ring — a departure only affects the few segments it was scattered across.
Failover just follows the normal clockwise lookup rule automatically; no operator has to migrate data by hand.

scenario: 现有 4 台库都接近容量上限，要加第 5 台，希望新机器立刻从所有旧机器身上卸压。
scenario_en: Four databases are all near capacity and a fifth is joining; the new machine should immediately take load off every existing one.
q: 加新节点时，虚拟节点带来什么好处？
options: 新节点上线后完全不需要接收任何数据，一切都等到下一次集群扩容时再统一批量处理即可
新节点可以先加入环，但延迟接收流量，得等运维手动开启才生效
新节点的虚拟位置散布全环，从多个现有节点各吸走一小块数据，集群一开始就均衡
新节点一旦加入环，就自动被推举为整个集群的主节点，无需选举
why: 没有虚拟节点时，新节点只从它唯一的顺时针邻居分流；有了虚拟节点，它从环上多处均匀取水，扩容效果立刻全局化。
why_en: A new node's virtual positions absorb small chunks from many existing nodes, balancing the cluster from the start instead of relieving only one neighbor.
options_en: The new node needs to receive no data at all once it joins, and everything is dealt with in one batch only at the next cluster scale-up.
The new node can join the ring but delay taking traffic until an operator manually flips it on.
The new node's virtual positions are spread across the whole ring, pulling a small chunk from many existing nodes so the cluster balances immediately.
The new node automatically becomes the entire cluster's primary the moment it joins the ring, with no election needed.
q_en: What benefit do virtual nodes bring when a new node joins?
optionExplanations: 新节点必须承担它虚拟位置对应的那部分数据，不是「完全不用接收」，否则加它就没意义了。
虚拟节点让新节点一加入就能立刻按环上位置服务，不需要运维手动延迟开启流量。
新节点的虚拟位置散布全环，从多个现有节点各吸走一小块数据，集群从加入那一刻就已经均衡。
加入哈希环只决定数据归属，不涉及集群里谁是主节点这种选主逻辑。
optionExplanations_en: The new node does have to take the data behind its virtual positions — otherwise adding it would accomplish nothing.
Virtual nodes let a new node start serving immediately by ring position; there's no manual delay an operator has to flip.
The new node's virtual positions are spread across the whole ring, pulling small chunks from many existing nodes so the cluster balances immediately.
Joining the ring only decides key ownership; it has nothing to do with electing a cluster primary.

scenario: 监控显示各库负载偏差达 ±30%，你想只调虚拟节点这一个旋钮把偏差压下来。
scenario_en: Monitoring shows per-database load deviating by plus or minus 30%, and you want to fix it by tuning just one knob: the virtual-node count.
q: 想让负载分布更均匀，虚拟节点数量应该怎么调？
options: 虚拟节点越少，负载分布反而越均匀
虚拟节点越多，负载分布越均匀
虚拟节点数量对负载均匀度没有影响
虚拟节点数量必须精确等于物理节点数量
why: 虚拟节点数是均匀度的旋钮：每台服务器的虚拟点越多，区间切得越碎、混排越充分，失效/扩容时的负载分摊越平滑。
why_en: The more virtual nodes per server, the more evenly load distributes across the ring.
options_en: Fewer virtual nodes means more even distribution.
More virtual nodes per server means more even distribution.
The number of virtual nodes has no effect on load evenness at all.
The number of virtual nodes must exactly equal the number of physical nodes.

termDefinitions.meaning: 给一台物理服务器在环上生成多个哈希位置的技术，用来让负载分布更均匀。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A virtual node technique hashes a physical server under several name variants so it occupies multiple ring positions for more even load.

q_en: How should you tune the number of virtual nodes for more even load?
optionExplanations: 区间切得越粗，负载反而越不均匀，这个方向说反了。
调大虚拟节点数相当于让每台机器在环上多处露脸，各节点的份额被切得更细，宕机或扩容的冲击也分散给更多邻居。
虚拟节点数量直接决定环上区间被切得多细，跟均匀度是强相关的，不是无关。

scenario: 100 节点的分片集群每周扩容一次，你要评估两种映射方案每次扩容分别要搬多少数据。
scenario_en: A hundred-node sharded cluster scales out weekly, and you compare how much data each mapping scheme has to move per scale-out.
q: 「节点数变化时要移动多少数据」——取模哈希 vs 一致性哈希？
options: 两者在节点数量发生变化时都会把集群里的全部数据整体重排，彼此之间没有任何本质差别可言
取模平均只移动约一半的数据，一致性哈希反而要移动全部数据
取模几乎全量重排；一致性哈希只移动相邻区间的 key，是有界的一小部分
两者都只移动新加入节点自身产生的新数据，历史数据完全不受影响
why: 这就是一致性哈希存在的意义：把「节点数变化 → 几乎全量搬迁」变成「只动相邻区间」，其余 key 原地不动。
why_en: Modulo hashing remaps nearly every key when the node count changes, while consistent hashing moves only the bounded range next to the change.
options_en: Both reshuffle the cluster's entire dataset when the node count changes, with no essential difference between them at all.
Modulo moves about half the data on average, while consistent hashing ends up moving all of it instead.
Modulo reshuffles nearly everything; consistent hashing moves only the keys in the adjacent range, a bounded slice.
Both only move the brand-new data written to the joining node, leaving all history completely untouched.
tradeoff: 取模哈希（几乎全量搬迁）vs 一致性哈希（只动相邻区间）

q_en: How much data moves when node count changes: modulo hashing versus consistent hashing?
optionExplanations: 两者其实差别巨大，说「没有本质差别」抹掉了一致性哈希存在的意义。
说反了：取模才是几乎全量重排，一致性哈希恰恰是把搬迁量降到最低的那个。
取模几乎全量重排；一致性哈希只让相邻区间的 key 移动，其余原地不动，这正是它被发明出来的原因。
两者节点变化时都要动已有数据，不只是新写入部分——取模动全部，一致性哈希动相邻区间。
optionExplanations_en: The two differ hugely; claiming no real difference erases the entire reason consistent hashing exists.
That's reversed: modulo is the one that reshuffles nearly everything, while consistent hashing is what minimizes the move.
Modulo reshuffles nearly every key; consistent hashing moves only the adjacent range, leaving the rest untouched — that's the whole point of it.
Both actually touch existing data when nodes change, not just new writes — modulo moves nearly all of it, consistent hashing only the adjacent slice.

scenario: 从零设计一个分布式缓存：节点会因扩容、故障频繁增减，缓存重建成本高，希望节点变化时尽量少的 key 失位。
q: 数据到节点的映射应该用？
options: 一致性哈希（哈希环 + 虚拟节点）
hash(key) % 节点数
轮询（round-robin）
按 key 首字母分配
why: 节点集合动态变化的场景正是一致性哈希的主场：增减节点只影响环上相邻区间，绝大多数缓存条目不失效。
why_en: With nodes frequently joining and leaving, consistent hashing keeps most cache entries in place since only adjacent ranges move.
whenOtherWins: 若节点集合固定不变（或像 Redis Cluster 那样用固定哈希槽集中调度），简单取模/固定槽位反而更容易推理。
options_en: Consistent hashing (hash ring plus virtual nodes).
hash(key) % number_of_nodes
Round-robin assignment.
Assign by the key's first letter.
tradeoff: 一致性哈希（动态增减节点更稳定）vs 简单取模（实现最简单但一变节点就大搬家）

termDefinitions.meaning: 按固定顺序依次把请求分配给各节点，不看 key 内容。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Round-robin assigns requests to nodes in a fixed rotating order, ignoring the key's content.

termDefinitions.meaning: 给一台物理服务器在环上生成多个哈希位置的技术，用来让负载分布更均匀。

q_en: Which data-to-node mapping should this distributed cache use?
scenario_en: You are designing a distributed cache from scratch. Nodes frequently join, fail, and leave, and cache rebuilds are expensive, so most keys should keep their owner.
optionExplanations: 节点会因扩容和故障频繁增减、又想保住多数缓存命中时，一致性哈希（环+虚拟节点）只让相邻区间失位，是这题的正解。
取模实现最简单，但节点数一变几乎全部 key 都要换库，缓存重建成本会被打爆，跟本题「节点常增减」的前提冲突。
轮询是无状态请求负载均衡的做法，不给 key 固定归属，同一个 key 会被打到不同节点，缓存根本命不中。
按首字母分配对业务 key 的偏斜毫无免疫力，热门首字母会压垮某些节点，节点变化时也没有明确的迁移规则。
optionExplanations_en: With nodes joining and failing often and wanting to keep most cache hits, consistent hashing (ring plus virtual nodes) only loses the adjacent range — the right call here.
Modulo is the simplest to implement, but nearly every key rehomes when N changes, which wrecks cache rebuild cost right where this scenario says nodes change often.
Round-robin is stateless load balancing with no fixed key ownership, so the same key can land on different nodes and cache hits just don't happen.
First-letter assignment has no defense against key skew — popular letters overload specific nodes, and there's no clean rule for handling membership changes.

scenario: 你在从零实现分布式缓存的路由层，节点位置已按环上坐标排序存放，要为一个 key 找到归属节点。
q: 哪个查找逻辑是正确的一致性哈希？
options: node = nodes[hash(key) % len(nodes)]，直接拿取模的余数当数组下标定位到节点
node = 与 hash(key) 数值最接近的那个节点，不管方向如何
node = random.choice(nodes)，每次都随机挑一个出来
pos = hash(key)，取环上从 pos 顺时针遇到的第一个节点（找不到则回绕到最小位置的节点）
why: 一致性哈希 = 在有序节点位置里找第一个 ≥ pos 的节点，越界则回绕到第一个；选项 A 是取模分片，「最接近」也不对——方向必须是顺时针。
why_en: Correct lookup finds the first node clockwise from the key's position, wrapping to the smallest position if none is larger.
whenOtherWins: 若用固定哈希槽方案（如 Redis Cluster 的 CRC16 mod 16384），查表槽位映射即可，不需要环上二分查找。
codeSample:
pos = hash(key) % RING_SIZE
# node_positions 已排序；找第一个 >= pos 的位置
idx = bisect_left(node_positions, pos)
node = ring_nodes[idx % len(ring_nodes)]  # 越界回绕到环起点
options_en: node = nodes[hash(key) % len(nodes)], taking the modulo remainder directly as the array index to locate the node.
node = the node whose position is numerically closest to hash(key), regardless of direction.
node = random.choice(nodes), picking a random one every single time.
pos = hash(key); take the first node clockwise from pos, wrapping to the smallest position if none is larger.
tradeoff: 环上二分查找+回绕（一致性哈希）vs 查表命中固定槽（Redis Cluster 式固定哈希槽）

termDefinitions.meaning: 沿环走到末尾后，逻辑上接回环的起点继续查找。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Wrap-around means that after reaching the end of the ring, the walk logically continues from the start.

termDefinitions.meaning: 在有序数组里通过不断折半来快速定位目标位置。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Binary search locates a target in a sorted array by repeatedly halving the search range.

q_en: Which lookup logic is correct for consistent hashing?
scenario_en: You are implementing a distributed-cache router. Node positions are sorted by ring coordinate, and the router must find the owner for a key.
optionExplanations: 这其实是取模分片的写法，数组下标直接由节点数量决定，跟环上顺时针查找是两套逻辑。
找数值最接近的节点没有固定方向，可能往逆时针找，破坏了一致性哈希「只顺时针」的归属规则。
随机选节点是无状态负载均衡，同一个 key 每次可能落到不同节点，不是稳定的数据路由。
先定位 key 在环上的位置，再找顺时针第一个 ≥ 它的节点，越界就回绕到最小位置——这才是一致性哈希的标准查找。
optionExplanations_en: This is actually modulo sharding — the array index depends directly on node count, a different mechanism from clockwise ring lookup.
Picking the numerically nearest node has no fixed direction and can go counter-clockwise, breaking the clockwise-only ownership rule.
Random node choice is stateless load balancing; the same key can land on a different node each time, not stable data routing.
Locate the key's ring position, then take the first node clockwise at or past it, wrapping to the smallest position if none is larger — that's the standard lookup.

scenario: 分片集群里 key 的数量在各节点分布很均匀，但一台节点长期 95% CPU，其余不到 20%。
scenario_en: Keys are spread evenly across the shards, yet one node sits at 95% CPU while the others stay under 20%.
q: 什么是热点（hot spot）？
options: 环上出现一段暂时没有任何节点覆盖的空白区间，导致哈希落进这段区间的 key 完全找不到归属节点
两个完全不同的 key 被哈希函数意外映射到了完全相同的一个环上位置
承载该分区的磁盘温度过高，因而触发了硬件层面的自动降频保护机制
某节点因承载了远比其他 key 热门的 key（如演唱会 100 倍读量）而流量失衡
why: 热点是流量维度的失衡：个别 key 的访问量碾压其他 key，承载它的节点被打爆——即使 key 的数量分布是均匀的。
why_en: A hot spot is a node overwhelmed by disproportionate traffic because some keys, like a Taylor Swift concert, are far more popular.
options_en: A stretch of the ring temporarily has no node covering it, so any key hashing into that stretch finds no owning node at all.
Two completely different keys happen to get hashed by accident onto the exact same ring position.
The disk holding that partition runs too hot and that triggers an automatic hardware-level throttling response.
A node overwhelmed with traffic because it holds a key far more popular than others, like a concert generating 100x the reads.

termDefinitions.meaning: 某个节点因承载了流量远超其他节点的 key 而被过度请求压垮。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A hot spot is a node overwhelmed by disproportionate traffic because it holds an especially popular key.

q_en: What is a hot spot?
optionExplanations: 环上没有覆盖的空白区间不是热点的定义，一致性哈希设计上本来就保证每段区间都有节点接住。
两个 key 撞在同一个环位置是哈希碰撞，跟流量失衡的热点是完全不同的问题。
磁盘温度过高是硬件层面的物理概念，和这里讨论的流量/负载失衡没有关系。
热点是流量维度的失衡：某节点因为承载的 key 远比其他 key 热门（比如演唱会 100 倍读量）而被流量打爆，即使 key 数量分布是均匀的。
optionExplanations_en: An uncovered gap on the ring isn't what a hot spot means — the design guarantees every stretch has an owning node.
Two keys landing on the same ring position is a hash collision, a completely different problem from traffic imbalance.
Disk overheating is a hardware-level physical concern, unrelated to the traffic and load imbalance being discussed here.
A hot spot is traffic imbalance: a node overwhelmed because it holds a key far more popular than others, like a concert with 100x the reads, even if key counts are even.

scenario: 票务系统里一场热门演唱会的 key 占了全站 40% 读流量，虚拟节点已配满仍被打爆。
scenario_en: In a ticketing system one hot concert key takes 40% of all read traffic, and the node melts even with plenty of virtual nodes.
q: 为什么一致性哈希（含虚拟节点）自己解决不了热点问题？
options: 因为哈希环的整个取值空间实在太小，只有大约 100 个刻度位置，根本完全不够分散这么多的 key
它均衡的是 key 数量分布，不是流量——超热 key 仍整体落在一个节点上
因为哈希函数不够随机，导致同一批 key 总是扎堆落在相邻位置
它其实能自动解决这个问题，只要把节点数量增加到足够多就行了
why: 一致性哈希保证 key 数量分得均匀，但单个 key 的全部流量仍指向同一个节点；流量失衡要靠复制或加盐这类额外手段。
why_en: Consistent hashing distributes keys evenly, not traffic, so one extremely popular key still lands entirely on a single node.
options_en: Because the hash ring's whole value space is far too small — only about a hundred tick positions, nowhere near enough to spread this many keys.
It balances how many keys land per node, not traffic — one super-hot key still sits entirely on one node.
Because the hash function is not random enough, so a whole batch of keys ends up clustering together.
It actually solves this automatically all by itself, as long as you add enough nodes to the cluster.

termDefinitions.meaningEn: A hot spot is a node overwhelmed by disproportionate traffic because it holds an especially popular key.

q_en: Why can’t consistent hashing, even with virtual nodes, solve hot spots by itself?
optionExplanations: 环的取值空间通常有 2^32 个刻度，远远不是瓶颈，问题不在刻度数量不够。
一致性哈希只保证 key 的数量分得均匀，单个超热 key 的全部流量仍然整体压在承载它的那一个节点上。
哈希函数不够随机不是主因，即使哈希均匀，单个热 key 天然只会落在一个位置，这是结构性限制不是随机性问题。
加节点只会让 key 分布更细，但那个超热 key 依旧只归一个节点，流量问题不会因此自动消失。
optionExplanations_en: The ring typically spans about 2^32 positions, nowhere near a bottleneck, so a small value space isn't the real issue.
Consistent hashing only keeps key counts even; one extremely hot key's entire traffic still lands on whichever single node holds it.
Hash randomness isn't the culprit — even with a perfectly even hash, one hot key structurally still maps to just one position.
Adding nodes only slices key distribution finer; the one hot key still belongs to a single node, so the traffic problem doesn't go away.

scenario: 电商大促，少数爆款商品 key 的 QPS 是普通商品的上千倍，要在不停机的前提下缓解。
scenario_en: During a flash sale a few hot product keys get thousands of times the QPS of normal ones, and we must relieve them without downtime.
q: 真实系统缓解热点的常用策略有哪些？（多选）
options: 读副本：把热门 key 复制到多个节点，读请求在副本间负载均衡（最常用）
key 加盐：给热 key 追加随机后缀（taylor-swift-{0..9}）使其散到不同节点
自适应再均衡：实时监控流量，把过载节点上的 key 区间挪走（DynamoDB 自动做）
增加虚拟节点数量就能消除热点
why: 三板斧：复制热 key 分摊读、加盐打散、自适应搬迁。加虚拟节点只能让 key 分布更均匀，对单个超热 key 无能为力。
why_en: Real systems use read replicas, key salting, and adaptive rebalancing, while more virtual nodes cannot fix a single hot key.

rows: 过载节点的 key 区间

options_en: Read replicas: copy the hot key to multiple nodes and load-balance reads across them (most common).
Key-space salting: append a random suffix to the hot key so it hashes to different nodes.
Adaptive rebalancing: monitor traffic in real time and move overloaded key ranges (DynamoDB automates this).
Simply adding more virtual nodes eliminates hot spots.

termDefinitions.meaning: 持有同一份数据只读拷贝的节点，用来分摊读请求。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A read replica holds a read-only copy of the data used to spread out read traffic.

termDefinitions.meaning: 给热 key 追加随机后缀拆成多个物理 key，分散到不同节点。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Key-space salting appends a random suffix to a hot key so it spreads across multiple physical keys and nodes.

termDefinitions.meaning: 系统实时监控流量并自动搬迁过载节点上的 key 区间。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Adaptive rebalancing monitors traffic in real time and automatically moves key ranges off overloaded nodes.

termDefinitions.meaning: AWS 的托管 NoSQL 数据库，内部用一致性哈希做分区路由。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: DynamoDB is AWS's managed NoSQL database that uses consistent hashing internally for partition routing.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把一个查询分发到多个节点并行执行，再把各节点结果合并返回。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Scatter-gather fans a query out to multiple nodes in parallel and merges their results into one response.

q_en: What common strategies do real systems use to mitigate hot spots?
optionExplanations: 读副本：把热 key 复制到多个节点，读请求在副本间分摊，挡住的是单点读压力过大——最常用的手段。
key 加盐：给热 key 加随机后缀拆成多个物理 key 散到不同节点，代价是读要 scatter-gather 再合并结果。
自适应再均衡：实时监控流量、把过载节点的 key 区间整体挪走，DynamoDB 这类系统能自动完成，代价是工程复杂度最高。
虚拟节点只让 key 数量分布更均匀，挡不住单个热 key 的全部流量，这个说法本身是错的。
optionExplanations_en: Read replicas: copy the hot key onto multiple nodes and spread reads across them, blocking single-node read overload — the most common fix.
Key-space salting: append a random suffix to split the hot key into several physical keys across nodes, at the cost of scatter-gather reads.
Adaptive rebalancing: watch traffic live and move an overloaded node's key range away entirely, which systems like DynamoDB automate, at the highest engineering cost.
Virtual nodes only even out key counts, not one hot key's traffic — this claim is simply wrong.

scenario: 票务系统：霉霉演唱会的读流量是其他活动的 100 倍，承载它的节点被读请求打爆，需要最常用、最直接的缓解手段。
q: 首选方案是？
options: 把整个集群的服务器规模直接扩容一倍，指望靠更多机器就能自动摊薄这一个热门 key 的压力
直接把这个热门 key 彻底删掉，让请求全部落空即可
把这个热门 key 复制到多个节点，读请求在这些副本间负载均衡
把哈希环的取值空间人为调小，让节点分布更加密集
why: 读热点的标准答案是读副本：多节点持有同一热 key，读请求分摊——这是实际系统中最常用的做法。
why_en: Replicating the popular key across multiple nodes and load-balancing reads among them is the most common hot-spot fix.
whenOtherWins: 若热点随时间漂移、难以预测，自适应再均衡（如 DynamoDB 的自动迁移）更合适；聚合类读也可用 key 加盐打散再汇总。
options_en: Just double the whole cluster's server count, hoping more machines alone automatically dilute this one hot key's pressure.
Delete the popular key outright, letting every request just come up empty.
Replicate the popular key to multiple nodes and load-balance reads across those replicas.
Deliberately shrink the hash ring's value space so nodes sit closer together on it.
tradeoff: 读副本分摊单点热流量 vs 扩容整个集群摊薄所有节点

termDefinitions.meaning: 某个节点因承载了流量远超其他节点的 key 而被过度请求压垮。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A hot spot is a node overwhelmed by disproportionate traffic because it holds an especially popular key.

termDefinitions.meaning: 持有同一份数据只读拷贝的节点，用来分摊读请求。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A read replica holds a read-only copy of the data used to spread out read traffic.

q_en: What is the first choice for this read hot spot?
scenario_en: In a ticketing system, one concert has 100 times the read traffic of other events, and the node holding that key is overloaded by reads.
optionExplanations: 扩容整个集群摊薄的是全站容量，这个超热 key 还是只归一个节点，热点节点照样被打爆。
删掉热门 key 是牺牲产品功能止血，不是工程缓解手段，用户直接看不到内容了。
把这个热门 key 复制到多个节点、读请求在副本间负载均衡，是读热点最常用、最直接的标准做法。
调小哈希空间只改变刻度密度，不会把单个 key 的流量拆开，反而可能增加碰撞。
optionExplanations_en: Doubling the whole cluster dilutes overall capacity, but the one super-hot key still belongs to a single node, so that node still gets overwhelmed.
Deleting the popular key sacrifices product functionality as a stopgap, not an engineering fix — users just see nothing.
Replicating the popular key across multiple nodes and load-balancing reads among them is the standard, most direct fix for a read hot spot.
Shrinking the hash space only changes tick density; it doesn't split one key's traffic apart, and can even raise collision odds.

scenario: 一个计数器热 key 要承接 50 万 QPS 写入，单节点写不动，必须把这一个 key 的压力拆开。
scenario_en: One hot counter key takes 500,000 writes per second, more than a single node can absorb, so that key’s load has to be split apart.
q: key 加盐（key-space salting）是怎么运作的？
options: 给热 key 追加随机后缀（0..9），分别哈希到不同节点，读时再分发聚合
把 key 的内容整体做加密后再存储，防止被未授权访问偷偷窃取查看
给每个 key 都追加一个时间戳字段，防止缓存条目意外过期失效
把所有 key 统一转换成小写字母存储，避免大小写不一致导致的误命中问题

Append a timestamp field to every single key so cache entries don't lapse unexpectedly.
Convert every key to lowercase letters uniformly before storing, avoiding case-mismatch misses.

q_en: How does key-space salting work?

Lowercasing keys is normalization to avoid case-mismatch misses, not a technique for spreading traffic across nodes.

实时监控流量、把过载节点的 key 区间挪走，DynamoDB 等系统能自动完成

固定夜间批处理是定时任务，不是「实时」响应流量变化，不符合自适应再均衡的特点。
实时监控流量，把过载节点的 key 区间挪走，DynamoDB 这类系统能自动完成，代价是运维复杂度高。
自适应再均衡设计上是在线搬迁，不需要让整个集群先停机才能执行。

A fixed nightly batch job is scheduled, not a real-time reaction to traffic, so it misses what makes rebalancing adaptive.
It watches traffic live and moves an overloaded node's key range away, something systems like DynamoDB automate, at the cost of operational complexity.
Adaptive rebalancing is designed to run online; the cluster doesn't need to go offline first.

虚拟节点防结构性失衡（key 分布不均）；复制和加盐防负载失衡（流量不均）
正好完全反过来：虚拟节点防的是流量失衡，而复制和加盐反而是用来防 key 数量分布不均的

why_en: Virtual nodes prevent structural imbalance in key distribution, while replication and salting prevent workload imbalance in traffic.

Virtual nodes prevent structural imbalance (uneven key counts); replication and salting prevent workload imbalance (uneven traffic).

q_en: In interviews, what imbalance do virtual nodes solve versus replication or salting?
optionExplanations: 虚拟节点管的是 key 数量分布是否均匀，说它完全不管这个就说反了。
虚拟节点防结构性失衡——key 在节点间分布不均；复制和加盐防负载失衡——个别 key 流量远高于其他，这是关键区分。

optionExplanations_en: Virtual nodes are exactly about whether key counts distribute evenly, so claiming they ignore that is backwards.
Virtual nodes guard against structural imbalance — uneven key distribution — while replication and salting guard against workload imbalance from a few hot keys, and that split is the key distinction.
That's the reverse: virtual nodes handle key-distribution structure, while replication and salting handle traffic, not the other way around.

scenario_en: In production each partition keeps three replicas; a node holding 2 TB fails, and recovery must not block live reads and writes.
q: 「一致性哈希告诉你数据该住哪，但不会瞬移 TB 级数据」——实践中节点失效怎么处理？
options: 运维必须连夜手动把失效节点上的全部数据，一条一条地拷贝到相邻节点上重新补齐才能恢复
大多数分布式数据库把复制和一致性哈希配合：失效靠现成副本顶上，无需搬数据
让失效节点原本负责的那部分数据，暂时整体变得完全不可读写
立即触发整个哈希环停机重建，所有节点都要重新排队入环等待
why: 正常时数据已复制在多个节点；一个节点失效后，该分区暂时少一份副本，但存活副本立刻接管读写——不用搬一个字节；代价是容错余量降低，得尽快补新副本。
why_en: Since data is already replicated across nodes, a failed node just leaves one partition short a replica while survivors keep serving reads and writes immediately, and the system must backfill a new replica soon to restore its fault margin.

Most distributed databases pair replication with consistent hashing: an existing replica takes over on failure, no data needs to move at all.
The data the failed node was responsible for becomes entirely unreadable and unwritable for a while.

q_en: In practice, how is node failure handled if consistent hashing cannot move terabytes instantly?
optionExplanations: 手动连夜搬数据是运维噩梦，也违背了「一致性哈希不瞬移 TB 级数据」这个前提想强调的自动化诉求。
大多数分布式数据库把复制和一致性哈希配合：节点失效时现成的副本直接接管读写，不用搬一个字节。
让那部分数据暂时整体不可用违背了副本机制存在的意义——正是为了故障时还能继续服务。
整个环停机重建的代价太大，只有节点失效这种局部事件，不需要牵动全环。

Most distributed databases pair replication with consistent hashing: on failure, an existing replica just takes over reads and writes with zero data movement.
Making that data entirely unavailable defeats the purpose of having replicas in the first place — they exist to keep serving through failures.
Rebuilding the whole ring offline is far too costly for a localized event like one node failing; it shouldn't touch the entire ring.

q: DynamoDB 是怎么做到「节点失效但数据不搬家」的？
options: 分区跨可用区复制存放，主副本失效后靠 leader election 选新主继续服务
把每个分区的数据定期打包备份到磁带库里，专门做长期冷存储归档保留起来
失效一发生就立刻从 S3 对象存储里拉取最近一次的全量快照，在新节点上反序列化恢复整个现场状态
只要集群里任意一个节点失效，就会立刻触发整个哈希环全部重新构建一遍
why: 副本预先跨可用区放好；主副本失效后 leader election 选新主、quorum 确认即可继续服务，不用搬数据；代价是切换瞬间有短暂延迟尖峰。
why_en: Replicas already sit across availability zones, so when the primary fails, leader election and quorum simply promote a healthy replica without moving data, at the cost of a brief latency spike during the switch.
scenario: DynamoDB 是 AWS 的托管 NoSQL 数据库，内部按分区做一致性哈希路由，每个分区会跨可用区保留多个副本。

As soon as any single node in the cluster fails, it immediately triggers a full rebuild of the entire hash ring.

q_en: How does DynamoDB handle node failure without moving data?
scenario_en: DynamoDB is AWS’s managed NoSQL database. It routes partitions with consistent hashing and keeps each partition replicated across availability zones.
optionExplanations: 分区的副本早就摆在不同可用区了，主的一挂，投票选出新主马上顶上，不用搬一个字节，代价是切换那一刻会有个小延迟毛刺。

全环重建代价过大，节点失效这种局部事件只需要在受影响的复制组内选主，不需要惊动整个环。
optionExplanations_en: Partitions are already replicated across availability zones, so when the primary fails, leader election promotes a healthy replica with no data to move, at the cost of a brief latency spike during the switch.
Archiving to tape is for long-term cold storage, not for recovering a failed primary that needs service back within seconds.
Pulling a full snapshot means network transfer and deserialization, far slower than simply continuing on a live replica, and isn't actually how DynamoDB works.
Rebuilding the whole ring is far too costly for a localized failure; only the affected replica group needs to elect a new leader.

q: Cassandra 在环上是怎么复制数据的？
options: 只在主节点存一份数据，其余节点完全没有任何副本备份
每次写入都随机挑选几个节点复制，具体位置完全不固定下来
把数据复制到环上连续的 N 个节点，节点失效时由幸存副本继续提供读
把所有数据无差别地复制到集群里的每一台节点上，让每个节点都各存一份完整的全量拷贝
why: 副本沿环顺时针存在连续 N 个节点上；某节点失效后，它负责的区间少了一份副本，但读写直接打到幸存副本继续服务；代价是容错余量下降，得尽快补齐副本数。
why_en: Replicas sit on N consecutive nodes around the ring, so a failed node just leaves one partition a replica short while reads and writes continue on the survivors, and the system needs to backfill a replica soon to restore its fault margin.

  B --> C["Next node replica"]

options_en: It stores only one copy on the primary node, with no replicas anywhere else at all.
It replicates to a few randomly chosen nodes on every write, with the positions never staying fixed.
It replicates each key to N consecutive nodes on the ring, so failed-node reads continue from surviving replicas.
It replicates all data indiscriminately onto every single node in the cluster, so each node keeps a full complete copy of everything.

q_en: How does Cassandra replicate data on the ring?
scenario_en: Cassandra is a decentralized wide-column database. Its nodes form a hash ring, and replicas are placed along the ring.
optionExplanations: 只存一份没有容错能力，节点一失效数据就真丢了，跟 Cassandra 的设计目标相反。
随机挑节点复制会让副本位置不可预测，读写时无法确定去哪几个节点找数据。
副本沿环顺时针存在连续的 N 个节点上，节点失效时幸存副本直接接手读写，不用临时决定副本放哪。
复制到集群里每一台节点存储成本随节点数线性暴涨，完全不是 Cassandra 实际采用的复制因子模型。
optionExplanations_en: Storing just one copy leaves no fault tolerance — a single node failure would genuinely lose data, the opposite of Cassandra's design goal.
Randomly picking replica nodes each time makes replica locations unpredictable, so reads and writes can't know where to look.
Replicas sit on N consecutive nodes going clockwise around the ring, so when one fails, surviving replicas keep serving reads and writes directly.
Copying to every single node makes storage cost scale linearly with cluster size, nothing like Cassandra's actual replication-factor model.

scenario_en: The cluster normally rides out node failures on replicas, and you must define which events may trigger expensive re-replication.
q: 既然故障靠副本顶，什么时候才会真的搬数据？
options: 每一次普通的读请求处理过程中，都会顺带触发一次数据搬迁动作
系统设了一个每天固定时间触发的定时任务，不管当天有没有发生成员变更都照常执行一整轮搬迁
从不搬数据，副本数量永远固定不变，再也不会补齐或做任何调整

why_en: Data only moves during planned membership changes like adding capacity, and even then consistent hashing bounds the fraction of keys re-replicated.
options_en: Every single normal read request happens to trigger a data-move as a side effect along the way.
The system runs a timer job triggered at a fixed time each day, executing a full migration round regardless of whether any membership change happened.
Data never moves at all; the replica count stays fixed forever and is never backfilled or adjusted.
Only during planned membership changes — adding capacity or replacing a node to restore the replication factor — moving just a bounded slice.

q_en: If replicas handle failures, when does data actually move?
optionExplanations: 普通读请求不会顺带触发搬迁，那样会让每次读都变成一次昂贵的数据迁移操作。
固定每天搬一次不看有没有变更是资源浪费，实际系统只在真正需要时才搬。
副本数量不是永远不变的，节点失效后必须补齐副本才能恢复原本的容错水平。
只有计划内的成员变更——加容量、永久换掉一台节点去补齐副本数——才会触发真正的搬迁，而且环把这次要动的比例限定在一个上界内。
optionExplanations_en: A normal read request doesn't trigger migration as a side effect — that would turn every read into an expensive data-move operation.
Running a fixed daily move regardless of whether anything changed wastes resources; real systems only move data when actually needed.

q: Redis Cluster 把 key 空间固定切成 16384 个槽，而不是切成 100 个或几百万个，这个数量级选择背后的设计考虑是什么？
options: 槽太少每槽扛太多 key、切分不精细；槽太多心跳传播的位图变笨重——16384 是折中
这只是历史遗留下来的随意选择，和心跳带宽、负载切分粒度都毫无关系
槽的数量必须和集群里的物理节点数量完全相等，16384 就意味着当年设计上限支持这么多个节点

why: 心跳包里带的槽位图每个槽占 1 bit：16384 个槽是 2 KB，65536 个槽就是 8 KB，每次 gossip 都带一次太重。另一头，Redis Cluster 设计上不预期超过约 1000 个 master 节点，16384 个槽足够把负载切细。两头折中就是 16384。（14 位只是表示一个槽编号所需的位数，不是位图大小。）
why_en: Every heartbeat carries a slot bitmap at one bit per slot: 16384 slots is 2 KB, 65536 would be 8 KB on every gossip message. On the other side, Redis Cluster is not expected to exceed about 1000 masters, so 16384 slots already splits load finely. That trade-off lands on 16384. (Fourteen bits is just the size of one slot number, not the bitmap.)

termDefinitions.meaning: 给一台物理服务器在环上生成多个哈希位置的技术，用来让负载分布更均匀。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A virtual node technique hashes a physical server under several name variants so it occupies multiple ring positions for more even load.

optionExplanations: 要能说清取模在节点数变化时几乎全量重排，一致性哈希把这个代价降到只动相邻区间。
要能说清虚拟节点让一台物理机在环上出现多个位置，节点失效或扩容的冲击被摊薄到多个邻居，不再压垮单点。
要能分清节点增减（结构性、靠环处理）和热点（流量性、靠复制/加盐处理）是两类不同问题，各自的缓解手段不能混用。
要能说清一致性哈希负责把数据放对节点，复制负责节点失效时不搬数据也能继续读写——两者配合才是完整的容错方案。
optionExplanations_en: Be ready to explain why modulo remaps nearly everything when node count changes, and how the ring bounds that cost to the adjacent range.
Be ready to explain how virtual nodes put one physical machine at several ring positions, spreading a failure or scale-out's impact across neighbors instead of overwhelming one.
Be ready to separate membership changes (structural, handled by the ring) from hot spots (traffic-driven, handled by replication or salting) — the fixes don't interchange.

Be ready to explain that consistent hashing places data on the right node while replication keeps serving reads and writes without moving data when a node fails — together they form the complete fault-tolerance story.

scenario: 团队想复用同一套一致性哈希路由库，问它除了数据库分片还能用在哪些组件上。
scenario_en: A team wants to reuse one consistent-hashing routing library and asks which components beyond database sharding it can serve.
q: 一致性哈希的适用范围，正确的说法是？
options: 任何把数据分布到一组服务器的场景都适用，覆盖数据库、缓存、消息队列
只能用在关系型数据库分片这一种特定场景里，缓存系统和消息队列等其他场景都完全套用不了
只能用在 CDN 边缘节点内容缓存这一件事情上，别无其他用途
只适合纯内存系统，任何涉及磁盘持久化的系统都完全不适用
why: 环上放的「节点」不限于数据库：缓存节点、broker、应用服务器都可以——本质是通用的「key → 服务器」映射方案。
why_en: Consistent hashing applies to any scenario distributing data across a cluster, whether databases, caches, message brokers, or app servers.
options_en: It applies to any scenario spreading data across a set of servers, covering databases, caches, and message queues.
It only applies to relational-database sharding specifically; caching systems, message queues, and other scenarios can't use it at all.
It only applies to the single case of picking a CDN edge node for content caching, nothing else.
It only suits pure in-memory systems; anything touching disk persistence doesn't apply at all.
q_en: What is the correct scope of consistent hashing?
optionExplanations: 放在环上的不必是数据库——缓存节点、消息队列的 broker、应用服务器，只要是「按 key 找机器」的场景都能套用这套映射。
缓存和消息队列同样面对「key 该落在哪台机器」的问题，一致性哈希在这些场景一样适用，不是只服务数据库分片。
CDN 只是一致性哈希的众多应用之一，不是它唯一能用的场景。
一致性哈希只是决定「哪个 key 归哪个节点」的映射逻辑，跟数据最终落在内存还是磁盘无关。
optionExplanations_en: The 'nodes' on the ring aren't limited to databases — cache nodes, message-broker nodes, app servers all fit the same key-to-server mapping.
Caches and message queues face the exact same 'which machine owns this key' problem, so consistent hashing applies there too, not only to database sharding.
CDNs are just one of many applications of consistent hashing, not the only place it can be used.
Consistent hashing is only the logic for deciding which node owns a key — it's independent of whether the data ends up in memory or on disk.

scenario: CDN 有 K 个内容 URL、N 个边缘节点；节点会扩缩容或上下线，不希望每次节点数变化都让大量缓存重新归属。
scenario_en: A CDN has K content URLs and N edge nodes. Nodes join and leave, and we do not want each membership change to remap most cached content.
q: CDN 内容映射该用简单取模还是一致性哈希？
q_en: Should CDN content mapping use simple modulo hashing or consistent hashing?
options: 用一个中心数据库记录每个 URL 具体存在哪个边缘节点上
每次请求都随机挑一个边缘节点去存放内容
按固定顺序轮询分配给各个边缘节点存放
一致性哈希：内容 URL 哈希到环上，就近顺时针归属边缘节点
why: 假设哈希均匀：取模从 N 加到 N+1，约 K×N/(N+1) 个 URL 会换节点；100 个节点加 1 个，接近 99% 会重映射。一致性哈希只让新节点接管一段环，平均搬 K/(N+1)。
why_en: With modulo hashing, adding one node remaps about K times N over N plus one keys, while consistent hashing moves only about K over N plus one keys.
whenOtherWins: 如果节点集合很小、几乎不变，简单取模或静态映射表也够用；一致性哈希主要赢在节点经常变化时。
options_en: A central database records exactly which edge node holds each URL.
Randomly pick an edge node to store the content each time.
Assign content to edge nodes in a fixed round-robin order.
Consistent hashing: hash the content URL onto the ring and assign it to the nearest clockwise edge node.
diagram:
flowchart LR A["简单取模 hash(url) % N"] --> B["N 变 N+1"] B --> C["多数 URL 换节点
约 K×N/(N+1) 要搬"] D["一致性哈希环"] --> E["新节点插入一段区间"] E --> F["只搬相邻区间
约 K/(N+1) 要搬"]
tradeoff: 简单取模（实现最简单但节点变化时大搬家）vs 一致性哈希（实现复杂些但迁移量小）

termDefinitions.meaning: 按固定顺序依次把请求分配给各节点，不看 key 内容。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Round-robin assigns requests to nodes in a fixed rotating order, ignoring the key's content.

termDefinitions.meaning: 用 hash(key) % N 选择节点；N 一变，旧 key 的余数关系也大多会变。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Modulo hashing picks a node with hash(key) % N; when N changes, most old keys map somewhere else.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把 key 和节点放到同一个环上，key 归顺时针遇到的第一个节点；节点变化只影响相邻区间。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Consistent hashing places keys and nodes on one ring, assigning each key to the next clockwise node so membership changes affect only nearby ranges.

optionExplanations: 中心数据库能精确控制，但每次查内容位置都要打这张表，节点一多它就成了单点瓶颈。
随机存放不保证同一个 URL 每次落到同一个边缘节点，请求会到处 miss，缓存价值归零。
轮询按固定顺序分配、不看 URL 内容，同样保不住内容归属的稳定性，节点变化时更难保持大部分缓存。
内容 URL 哈希到环上、就近顺时针归属边缘节点，节点变化时只有相邻内容重新归属，大部分缓存条目保持不变。
optionExplanations_en: A central database gives precise control, but every lookup hits that table, and it becomes a single bottleneck as nodes grow.
Random placement doesn't guarantee the same URL lands on the same edge node twice, so requests miss everywhere and cache value drops to zero.
Round-robin assigns in a fixed order and ignores URL identity, so it can't keep content ownership stable either, especially as nodes change.
Hashing the content URL onto the ring and assigning it to the nearest clockwise edge node means only adjacent content reassigns when nodes change, keeping most cache entries intact.

scenario: 面试中你说「我们用一致性哈希」，面试官反问这个术语到底指哪一种实现。
scenario_en: In an interview you say "we use consistent hashing" and the interviewer asks which implementation that term actually refers to.
q: Kleppmann（DDIA）对「一致性哈希」这个词的提醒是？
options: 这个词已经被业界正式弃用了，学术界改用别的术语来称呼这套原则
只有严格按最初学术论文一字不差实现的版本，才真正配称为一致性哈希
这个词用得很宽泛：有些系统实为固定槽分区而非教科书环，核心是最小化数据移动
所有自称使用一致性哈希的系统，无一例外都精确无误地复刻了教科书上那套标准的环结构
why: 别较真术语：实现可以是环、也可以是固定槽变体，核心原则始终是「节点变化时尽量少搬数据」。
why_en: The term is used loosely in practice; what matters is the principle of minimizing data movement during rebalancing, not the textbook ring.
options_en: The term has been formally deprecated across the industry, and academics now use a different name for it.
Only an implementation matching the original academic paper verbatim truly deserves to be called consistent hashing.
The term gets used loosely: some systems that claim it are really fixed-slot partitioning, not a ring — what matters is minimizing movement.
Every single system that claims to use consistent hashing, without exception, precisely replicates the textbook standard ring structure.

termDefinitions.meaning: Martin Kleppmann 撰写的分布式系统经典教材。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: DDIA is Martin Kleppmann's well-known book on designing data-intensive applications.

q_en: What warning does Kleppmann in DDIA give about the term consistent hashing?
optionExplanations: 这个词从没被正式弃用，业界和学术界都还在广泛使用它。
较真到一字不差复刻论文实现没有必要，工程实践里很多变体都被公认为一致性哈希家族。
这个词用得很宽泛：有些系统实为固定槽分区而非教科书环，核心原则始终是「节点变化时最小化数据移动」。
并不是所有系统都精确复刻教科书环结构——Redis Cluster 用的固定槽就是一个典型的变体。
optionExplanations_en: The term has never been formally deprecated — both industry and academia still use it widely.
Insisting on a verbatim reimplementation of the original paper isn't necessary; many practical variants are still widely accepted as consistent hashing.
The term gets used loosely: some systems that claim it are really fixed-slot partitioning, not a textbook ring — the core principle is always minimizing data movement when membership changes.
Not every system precisely replicates the textbook ring — Redis Cluster's fixed slots are a clear example of a variant.

q: 补全一致性哈希的一句话总结：
text: 把数据和服务器都放到{{环}}上、沿{{顺时针}}走找归属节点；节点增减时只有{{相邻区间}}的数据需要移动，其余原地不动。
why: 实现细节可以复杂，核心图景极简：一个圆环 + 顺时针行走。这句话就是面试里 30 秒讲清一致性哈希的骨架。
why_en: Arrange everything on a ring and walk clockwise, so only the adjacent range of keys moves when membership changes.
q_en: Fill in the one-sentence summary of consistent hashing:
text_en: Put data and servers on a {{ring}}, walk {{clockwise}} to find the owner, and only the {{adjacent range}} moves when nodes join or leave.

q: 把「从取模分片演进到一致性哈希 + 虚拟节点」的决策链排成正确顺序：
steps: 选型：一致性哈希——数据与节点放同一个环上，顺时针定位
缓解：虚拟节点把每个节点打散到环上多个位置，失效负载均摊
需求：数据分片到多台实例，且节点会因扩容/故障增减
残留代价：节点失效时其全部数据砸给唯一的顺时针邻居，负载翻倍
问题：取模哈希在节点数变化时几乎全量 key 重新映射
why: 需求（动态节点）→ 问题（取模全量重排）→ 选型（哈希环）→ 代价（邻居接盘过载）→ 缓解（虚拟节点）。这条链就是面试的标准叙事。
why_en: Dynamic membership breaks modulo hashing, the ring localizes movement, its neighbor-overload cost is then fixed by virtual nodes.
diagram:
flowchart LR
    R["需求：节点会增减"] --> P["问题：取模几乎全量重排"]
    P --> C["选型：哈希环+顺时针"]
    C --> K["代价：失效负载砸给单个邻居"]
    K --> M["缓解：虚拟节点均摊"]
tradeoff: 取模哈希（简单但节点变化时全量搬迁）vs 一致性哈希+虚拟节点（局部搬迁+失效负载摊薄）

q: 把「热点问题的识别与缓解」推理链排成正确顺序：
steps: 缓解：把热 key 复制到多个节点，读请求负载均衡（最常用）
现象：个别 key（如霉霉演唱会）流量是其他 key 的 100 倍
后果：承载热 key 的那个节点被流量打爆，成为热点
进阶：key 加盐打散，或自适应再均衡自动搬迁
认识：一致性哈希均衡的是 key 分布，不是流量
why: 现象（超热 key）→ 认识（哈希只均衡 key 不均衡流量）→ 后果（单节点被打爆）→ 缓解（复制读副本）→ 进阶（加盐/自适应）。
why_en: A wildly popular key overwhelms one node because hashing balances keys not traffic, mitigated first by replication and then by salting or adaptive rebalancing.

termDefinitions.meaning: 某个节点因承载了流量远超其他节点的 key 而被过度请求压垮。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A hot spot is a node overwhelmed by disproportionate traffic because it holds an especially popular key.

termDefinitions.meaning: 持有同一份数据只读拷贝的节点，用来分摊读请求。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A read replica holds a read-only copy of the data used to spread out read traffic.

termDefinitions.meaning: 给热 key 追加随机后缀拆成多个物理 key，分散到不同节点。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Key-space salting appends a random suffix to a hot key so it spreads across multiple physical keys and nodes.

scenario: 面试官追问：「你的分布式缓存每个 key 存 2 个副本，现在一个节点挂了，怎么保证既不丢缓存价值、又不在故障当下搬大量数据？」
q: 最完整的回答思路是？
options: 把那台挂掉的节点直接重启一下就行，数据会自动完整恢复回来变正常
一致性哈希只影响该节点区间 + 虚拟节点摊薄冲击 + 副本直接接管读写，故障当下无需大规模搬数据（之后后台补齐副本数）
把整个缓存集群里的全部数据统统推倒、从头彻底重建一遍，之后才能继续正常投入使用对外服务
把全部流量都临时切换到数据库上，彻底绕开缓存层不再经过它处理请求
why: 三层递进：环把影响限制在该节点的区间、虚拟节点把这段区间摊给多个邻居、已有副本直接接管服务，所以故障当下不需要大规模搬数据；之后为了恢复副本数，后台会把这些区间再复制一份到其他节点。
why_en: Three layers: the ring confines impact to that node's ranges, virtual nodes spread those ranges across several neighbors, and existing replicas take over serving, so no large move is needed at failure time; afterwards the system re-replicates those ranges in the background to restore the replica count.
whenOtherWins: 若数据可容忍全部重建（纯缓存、回源成本低），也可以接受简单方案：挂了就让相应 key 未命中、自然回填。
options_en: Just restart the failed node and its data automatically recovers back to normal completely.

Consistent hashing limits impact to that node's range, virtual nodes spread the hit, and replicas take over reads and writes, so no large data move is needed at failure time (re-replication catches up in the background).
Tear down all the data across the entire cache cluster and rebuild it from scratch before it can go back into normal service.
Temporarily route every bit of traffic to the database, entirely bypassing the cache layer so it no longer handles requests.
tradeoff: 组合方案（环局部化+虚拟节点摊薄+副本零搬迁）vs 简单粗暴方案（全量重建或直接打库）

termDefinitions.meaning: 给一台物理服务器在环上生成多个哈希位置的技术，用来让负载分布更均匀。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A virtual node technique hashes a physical server under several name variants so it occupies multiple ring positions for more even load.

termDefinitions.meaning: 同一份数据的多个拷贝，分布在不同节点上用于容错。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A replica is a copy of the same data kept on a different node for fault tolerance.

q_en: What is the most complete answer path?
scenario_en: The interviewer asks: your distributed cache keeps two replicas per key and one node has failed — how do you preserve cache value without moving a large amount of data at failure time?
optionExplanations: 重启只能恢复进程本身，不保证机器真的物理不可用时数据还在，也没解释为什么不用搬大量数据。
一致性哈希把冲击限制在该节点区间，虚拟节点把冲击摊薄给多个邻居，副本直接接管服务——三层叠加才是既保住缓存价值又不搬数据的完整答案。
全量重建等于把所有缓存价值清空重新预热，回源压力和延迟都会飙升，跟「不丢缓存价值」的要求相反。
全部切到数据库绕开缓存层，会把故障的压力直接转移给数据库，可能把数据库打穿。
optionExplanations_en: Restarting only revives the process; it doesn't guarantee data survives a real hardware failure, and it doesn't explain why large data moves aren't needed.

The ring limits the blast radius to that node's range, virtual nodes spread it across several neighbors, and replicas take over serving directly — stacking all three is the complete answer that keeps cache value without moving data.
A full rebuild throws away all cached value and re-warms from scratch, spiking origin load and latency — the opposite of preserving cache value.
Routing everything to the database bypasses the cache layer and dumps the failure's pressure straight onto the database, risking overload there.

scenario: 一个一致性哈希集群有 K 个 key、N 个节点,虚拟节点已把环基本均分;现在为扩容再加入第 N+1 个节点,你要估算这次平均要搬多少 key。
scenario_en: A consistent-hashing cluster holds K keys across N nodes, with virtual nodes splitting the ring evenly. You add an (N+1)-th node for capacity and estimate how many keys move on average.
q: 一致性哈希从 N 扩到 N+1 个节点,平均搬多少 key?
q_en: Scaling a consistent-hashing ring from N to N+1 nodes, how many keys move on average?
options: 约 K/(N+1):新节点只接管环上属于它的那一段,其余 key 原地不动
约 K×N/(N+1):几乎每个 key 的归属都改变,近乎全量重排——这其实是取模的结局
约 K/2:新节点和相邻的那个旧节点把数据对半分担
0:一致性哈希扩容零迁移,已有 key 完全不动
why: 均匀哈希下环被 N+1 个节点平分,新节点只切走约 K/(N+1),取模却要动约 K×N/(N+1)(100 节点加 1 近 99%)。这是推导值非 SLO:N 越大单次成员变更迁移越少,大集群扩缩容更便宜。
why_en: Under uniform hashing a new node claims only about K over N plus one keys, while modulo remaps K times N over N plus one — nearly ninety-nine percent at a hundred nodes.
options_en: About K/(N+1): the new node claims only its own arc of the ring and every other key stays put.
About K×N/(N+1): almost every key changes owner, a near-total reshuffle — that is actually modulo's outcome.
About K/2: the new node and its adjacent old node split the data evenly between them.
Zero: consistent hashing moves nothing on scale-out and all existing keys stay put.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把一个物理节点哈希成环上多个点,让环被更均匀地平分,搬迁量才接近 K/(N+1) 的理想值。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Virtual nodes hash one physical node to many ring points so the ring splits evenly, which is why movement approaches the ideal K/(N+1).

termDefinitions.meaning: 用 hash(key) % N 决定归属;N 一变,几乎所有 key 的余数都变,导致近全量重映射。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Modulo hashing picks a node with hash(key) mod N; when N changes almost every key's remainder changes, remapping nearly everything.

termDefinitions.meaning: 服务等级目标:团队对延迟、可用性等指标承诺的量化目标值,是给定前提而非公式推导结果。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An SLO, or Service Level Objective, is a quantified target a team commits to for metrics like latency or availability — a given, not a derived result.

optionExplanations: 均匀哈希下新节点只切走属于自己的 1/(N+1) 环段,搬迁量约 K/(N+1),这正是一致性哈希的价值。
K×N/(N+1) 是取模(hash%N→%(N+1))的结局:百节点扩容近乎全量重排,一致性哈希正是为避免它而生。
对半分只在恰好两个节点时近似成立;N 大时新节点只接管一小段环,不是和邻居平分全部数据。
扩容仍要搬相邻区间的约 K/(N+1) 个 key,不是零迁移;近零迁移的是靠副本顶替的故障场景。
optionExplanations_en: Under uniform hashing the new node takes only its own 1/(N+1) arc, moving about K/(N+1) keys — the whole point of consistent hashing.
K×N/(N+1) is modulo's outcome (hash%N → %(N+1)): 100 nodes plus one remaps nearly 99%, which consistent hashing exists to avoid.
An even split only roughly holds at exactly two nodes; with large N the new node claims a small arc, not half of a neighbor's data.
Scale-out still moves the adjacent ~K/(N+1) keys, not zero; near-zero movement is the failure case handled by replicas, not scaling.
